newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica's Delta says in talks with GM.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica's Delta says in talks with GM.

text.p: South African automobile manufacturer Delta Motor Corporation said on Thursday it was currently engaged in talks with General Motors Corp on increased cooperation.

"As a result of the changed political circumstances in South Africa, and in pursuit of its global business strategy, GM has approached Delta to discuss the potential for increased cooperation in the mutual interests of the parties," Delta said in a statement.
The company said discussion with the U.S. automaker were currently in progress.
